items.question: How much does a managed website cost?
items.answer: Plans start at $249/month for Lite, $449/month for Business and $749+/month for E-Commerce, billed monthly in USD with no activation fee. See our Pricing page for the full comparison.

items.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
items.answer: No. Every plan is month-to-month with no long-term contract and no activation fee — cancel anytime.

items.question: Who owns the website and domain?
items.answer: You always own your domain. Source-code and content ownership and buyout/transfer terms will be set out in our Subscription Terms, which are being finalized (TBD).

items.question: What if I need something updated?
items.answer: Lite includes 10 content updates a month; Business and E-Commerce include unlimited content updates. Larger requests outside a normal update are quoted separately.

items.question: Can I cancel?
items.answer: Yes — every plan is month-to-month with no long-term contract, so you can cancel anytime. Our content-export and buyout process is being finalized (TBD) and will be published in full in our Subscription Terms before launch.

items.question: How long does it take to see my preview website?
items.answer: Timelines depend on your business and the information you provide. We confirm an expected timeframe when we review your application.

items.question: Am I guaranteed a free preview?
items.answer: Not automatically. We review every application to make sure we can create something genuinely useful for your business before building a preview.

items.question: Can I add pages to my website later?
items.answer: Yes. New pages and page changes are covered by your plan's monthly content-update allowance — 10 updates a month on Lite, unlimited on Business and E-Commerce — at no extra cost within that allowance.

items.question: What does "unlimited content updates" actually include?
items.answer: On Business and E-Commerce, it covers text, images, sections and layout changes to your existing site. It doesn't include full custom redesigns or new third-party integrations, which are scoped and quoted separately.

items.question: Can I upgrade my plan later?
items.answer: Yes, at any time. We move your site to the new plan's features without rebuilding it from scratch or any downtime.
